text:
maya: follow-up from today's streaming outage. observed long-tail request timeouts + partial chunking during a rapid scale event. Tentative root cause: handshake/backoff mismatch + transient worker cold-start queueing. Action items below; pick owners or nominate.
aj: I'll own client reconnect behavior + SDK patch. Plan: add jittered exponential backoff, shorten handshake retry window from 10s->3s, and expose a clear PartialChunk error for clients to surface. Draft PR by Wed EOD, staging tests by Fri.
simon: I'll own server timeout tuning and circuit breakers. Need a client sim to reproduce head-of-line queueing (AJ can share). Will add temporary inflight_per_session cap (8) as a low-risk canary tonight. Monitor errors and latency.
liz: I'll add telemetry + dashboards. Metrics: partial_chunk_rate, handshake_fail_rate, session_backlog_p50/p95, inflight_per_session. Alerts: partial_chunk_rate > 0.5% for 10m, handshake_fail_rate spike. ETA: next Wed.
priya: I'll own the postmortem note + runbook updates. Will add a "disable streaming" mitigation checklist and oncall playbook. Proposing weekly review for 4 weeks.
incident-bot: created STREAM-4821 (reconnect-sdk), STREAM-4822 (timeout-tuning), STREAM-4823 (telemetry-dashboards), STREAM-4824 (runbook-update).
aj: client sim: https://git.internal/redwood/stream-client-sim  I'll push scripts for handshake windows (2s/10s) and high-concurrency modes.
simon: hypothesis: autoscaler spin-up + cold workers cause head-of-line blocking leading to partial responses. Intermediate mitigation: canary inflight cap tonight; roll further if stable.
maya: owners & deadlines: aj -> SDK PR Wed EOD; simon -> canary tonight, rollout by Fri if stable; liz -> dashboards next Wed; priya -> doc+runbook by Mon. Weekly follow-ups Thu 10:00am for 4 weeks. Update STREAM tickets with PRs and test logs.
liz: adding PagerDuty escalation if partial_chunk_rate > 0.5% for 10m and including rollback steps.
aj: also adding server-side feature flag to disable streaming for heavy sessions (KILL switch) with rollout plan.
maya: thanks all. I'll post a one-line update to #all-hands after SDK merges and canary finishes. Please add timestamps and artifacts to ticket comments.
